name: DetectWild
description: The misuse of AI-generated text has heightened the need for detection mechanisms. However, existing detection methods are based on synthetic datasets obtained from controlled environments, which fails to capture the complexities of real-world scenarios. To address this, we introduce DetectWild<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>, an in-the-wild AI-generated text detection benchmark sourced from a genuine Chinese Q&A platform, where the performance of existing detectors drops compared with synthetic data.
